violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT THE BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED SPONGES INSIDE OF HANDWASHING SINK BY THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: SPONGES REMOVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: IN WALK-IN COOLER: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE RAW VEGETABLES AND RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE CHEESE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW ANIMAL PRODUCTS MOVED TO LOWER SHELVES, BELOW RTE FOODS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER: COOKED ONIONS AT 46F, COOKED CHICKEN AT 48F, LAMB GYRO AT 45F. FOODS WERE PLACED IN COOLER 2.5HRS PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS FOODS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER TO RAPID COOL. THIS COOLER MUST BE TURNED DOWN TO ~33F TO COMPENSATE FOR THE HIGH HEAT COMING OFF THE PIZZA OVEN. PLEASE LOWER TEMPERATURE OF THE UNIT AND CONTINUE TO MONITOR TEMPERATURES OF THE FOOD TO ENSURE IT IS 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OBSERVED COOKED ONIONS, COOKED MIXED VEGETABLES, AND COOKED CHICKEN DATED ~2/20 INSIDE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: TCS ITEMS DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE COOLERS ARE LOOKED THROUGH MULTIPLE TIMES A WEEK TO ENSURE FOOD EXCEEDING 7 CALENDAR DAYS (INCLUDING DATE OF PREPARATION) ARE USED OR DISPOSED OF AS INDICATED ABOVE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED FOODS SUCH AS COOKED MIXED VEGETABLES, COOKED RICE, TOMATO SAUCE, HUMMUS, COOKED MEATS NOT DATED.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: PIC WAS RE-EDUCATED AND INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO BEGIN DATE MARKING PROPERLY. FORNI (Inspection Date: 03/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed spray bottles of chemicals stored on the same shelf as clean equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO MOVE THE CHEMICALS TO A SEPARATE LOCATION AWAY FROM CLEAN EQUIPMENT, FOOD, SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS, ETC.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND BEGAN LABELING WORKING CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED INSIDE OF ICE MACHINE TO HAVE MOLD BUILD UP.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. INCREASE THE CLEANING FREQUENCY OF INSIDE OF ICE MACHINE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sugar, salt, flour
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of various spices.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no cover to the feminine napkin refuse container in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
